# Outer dimensions
outer_x = 220  # mm
outer_y = 300  # mm
outer_z = 160  # mm

# Wall and bottom thickness
wall_thickness = 8  # mm
bottom_thickness = 12  # mm

# Calculate inner dimensions
inner_x = outer_x - 2 * wall_thickness
inner_y = outer_y - 2 * wall_thickness
inner_z = outer_z - bottom_thickness  # Only subtract bottom thickness from z

# Calculate position of inner block (offset by wall thickness)
inner_x_pos = wall_thickness
inner_y_pos = wall_thickness
inner_z_pos = bottom_thickness

print(f"Outer box dimensions: {outer_x} x {outer_y} x {outer_z} mm")
print(f"Inner cavity dimensions: {inner_x} x {inner_y} x {inner_z} mm")
print(f"Inner cavity position: ({inner_x_pos}, {inner_y_pos}, {inner_z_pos})")
